note.en: A tiny snail under 1 cm that lives in rubble. It has been collected at Cahuita and Manzanillo at 3 to 24 m, but divers do not see it.
note.es: Un caracol diminuto de menos de 1 cm que vive en el escombro. Se ha recolectado en Cahuita y Manzanillo entre 3 y 24 m, pero los buzos no lo ven.

sources.t: GBIF occurrence records, Gandoca to Limón (INBio ATTA survey 1998 to 2003 and museum specimens)
